title: Rate limit the public API per key — round 2

change.title: Rate limit the public API per key

proposals.title: The limit should be per plan, not a constant
proposals.body: Now read from `limitFor(req.apiKey.plan)`, as you asked; the plan table is in `billing/plans.ts`.

proposals.title: Retry-After should come from the key's TTL
proposals.body: `redis.ttl(key)` gives the exact wait; the clock arithmetic drifts from Redis's expiry.

proposals.title: Cache the plan limit on the key
proposals.body: `limitFor` reads the plan table on every request.
